prompt: Research one commercial-space infrastructure and geospatial-data investment idea.

inputs.seed_claim: Reusable launch, proliferated constellations, defence procurement, and a possible public SpaceX may create a listed stack spanning launch, spacecraft, lunar logistics, Earth data, and sensors.
inputs.drivers: Launch cadence and cost; defence and civil budgets; constellation replenishment; satellite communications; Earth-observation subscriptions; lunar contracts; sovereign demand.
inputs.value_chain: Launch providers; satellite and spacecraft systems; lunar logistics; Earth-observation data; defence sensors and mission systems.
inputs.supporting_evidence: The seed requires cadence and reuse to lower cost, backlog conversion, recurring connectivity and data, reliable missions, and government-supported scale.
inputs.invalidation: Launch or mission failure, schedule slips, fixed-price losses, capital intensity, funding needs, or customer concentration.
